model.name: R20.9: Landscape orientation uses the wide space — side-by-side panels instead of portrait stack.
model.description: In LANDSCAPE orientation, the layout MUST use the wide horizontal space — side-by-side panels (tree/list on LEFT + detail/drawer on RIGHT) instead of the portrait vertical stack (room-tree top + drawer bottom). Current portrait-stacked layout wastes space in landscape: cramped tree, narrow drawer, empty areas. Applies to room view + /trace + drawer. Responsive: portrait = vertical stack (current), landscape = horizontal side-by-side. Media query or orientation detection switches the layout.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "landscape is unnecessarily wasting space. use it."

intendedChain.useCase: layout.landscapeResponsive — landscape orientation renders side-by-side (tree LEFT + drawer RIGHT)
intendedChain.method: @media (orientation: landscape) layout switch — flex-direction:row, tree+drawer side-by-side
intendedChain.test: RED: set viewport to landscape (width > height) → assert tree/list and drawer render SIDE BY SIDE (not stacked). Portrait → assert stacked. Currently FAILS (landscape = stacked, wastes space).
